adjudication.novelty: New exact September 8 official campaign article after the prior September 7 global end; same existing USDT Flexible overlay, not a new mechanism.
adjudication.deduplication: No exact article-code hit in retained docs, tools or data JSON/JSONL before access.
adjudication.source_gate: Require successful exact article identity and its complete bonus/base APR, principal tier cap, minimum, dates, accrual/redemption, eligibility and change-reservation clauses. Missing terms remain unknown.
adjudication.comparison: Independently existing idle same-account USDT against leaving the same USDT available; no new purchase, transfer, borrowing or subscription.
adjudication.economics: Separate capped bonus from variable base APR; no stacking with expired or regional campaigns without explicit terms. Compute only conditional gross bonus per explicitly eligible complete UTC accrual day and remaining horizon. Exclude variable APR from any fixed-rate calculation.
adjudication.qualification: No accepted-edge count change, no account qualification or guaranteed forward reward. Require actual same-account eligibility, quota, realized cash flows and best available alternative after costs before deployment.
adjudication.outcome_policy: Stop after this one source. No aliases, refetch, price or account escalation. One offline adjudication of retained bytes is allowed, never repairs a failed capture.
adjudication.retry: Material independently observed terms change or exact source-proved campaign end; no daily polling.
